validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 766 cases with 286 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: Live profiling after the 0.4.9 install showed the plugin at 9.7% of samples during an active turn (down from 84.3%) with the remaining frames being whole-document validation of stored history/window/instrument/runtime documents per read and a stored-session stat on every header lookup (measured ~82 per second while a turn was active). Every stored document parser now reuses the validated value it already produced, and header-derived session facts are reused for a short window, so repeated authorization lookups no longer re-parse documents or stat stored sessions.
validation.privacy: Only six closed assets published; no local raw logs, profile snapshots or session evidence

review.independentReview: dynamic profiling and a plugin/filesystem audit performed by delegated investigators against the running process
